description: Found while landing fz-21x.9 (2026-09-13). src/compiler2/native_codegen/receive.rs keeps DispatchRuntimeHelpers (20 Option<FuncId>) and DispatchRuntimeRefs (20 Option<FuncRef>), a parallel declare-up-front table for the receive-dispatch body, which is emitted through a bare FunctionBuilder rather than a CodegenFn and so cannot use runtime_call!. Every Option is unconditionally Some (one caller). The helpers are now populated from the Rust items (dispatch_runtime_helpers in driver.rs), so no hand-written signature survives, but the two structs are the same idea runtime_syms.rs was. Fix: give DispatchCtx a RuntimeCaller (module + builder + per-body memo) and call helpers by item at each site; delete both structs and dispatch_runtime_helpers. No behaviour change; proof is the receive fixtures on three doors.
title: Receive-dispatch body calls runtime helpers through two parallel 20-field tables
